'''Trill''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]], Trill was part of [[Special Operations Group Five]], sent to [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] on a mission to start a mass riot. When [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Oklart]] and Colonel Trill were approached by the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]], who demanded the whereabouts of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Melicoste]], Trill attempted to withhold that information; however, Oklart felt it was necessary to assist the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in any way possible and revealed Melicoste's destination. Trill felt that would be equal to condemning fellow soldiers to death and accused Oklart of [[Treason/Legends|treason]]. When Oklart attempted to manipulate the Wrath into killing Trill, Trill realized that he was trying to escape his upcoming court-martial. The Wrath killed Oklart in response to this revelation.
